tipo.title: What do you need?
tipo.description: Choose jobs for individual postings or companies for one employer record per company. In company mode, country, technology, and keyword filters apply; job-only filters are ignored.

country.title: Country (ISO-2)
country.description: Jobs: filter posting country. Companies: filter the country on the company record. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as IT, DE or US; empty means worldwide.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Jobs: exact match against extracted technologies, such as SAP, Snowflake or Kubernetes. Companies: filter the company-level technology aggregate; this is not a distinct-employers query over the filtered jobs.

q.title: Keyword
q.description: Jobs: search job titles and descriptions. Companies: search company names case-insensitively. Leave empty for no keyword filter.

seniority.title: Seniority
seniority.description: Return only postings with the selected seniority. Leave empty to include all postings; not used in company mode.

remote.title: Workplace
remote.description: Return only postings with the selected workplace type. Leave empty to include all postings; not used in company mode.

dal.title: Posted after
dal.description: Return postings dated on or after this ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), for example 2026-10-01. Posting dates may be estimated when the source has no exact date. Leave empty for no date filter; not used in company mode.

limite.title: Max results
limite.description: Maximum rows to return (1–10,000; default 100). You pay only for job or company rows returned: $0.003 per row ($3 per 1,000). An empty result costs $0.
